summary: Learn to govern AI agents with approval workflows, oversight, escalation, and monitoring. Review the course outline and training details.
lede: AI agent governance training covers controls for systems that take actions toward assigned goals. It is for AI product owners, automation teams, customer service managers and risk professionals who assess agent use cases, map permissions, and set human review and escalation points. Practical exercises include documenting audit evidence and defining indicators for monitoring agent failures.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who own, build, supervise, or assess AI agents operating in customer service, operations, and knowledge-work processes.
prerequisites: No formal prerequisite is specified. Familiarity with an AI-enabled workflow, copilot, or automation use case will help you apply the exercises. Coding is not required; bring a laptop for document and spreadsheet-based work.
